data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew name חמלני (Chamalni), derived from חמל (chamal) meaning 'to carry' and אל (El) meaning 'God'. The name Hamlani is a beautiful tribute to a faithful servant of God. The name Hamlani carries the meaning “Friend of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Hamlani usually hope their child will grow to embody friend of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hamlani total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
